1.title: Without Saying His Name, Ken Paxton’s Estranged Wife Tells Texans to Vote For Him
1.summary: In a new ad, the wife of Ken Paxton, who is divorcing him for alleged adultery, tells Texas voters to focus on the “whole team,” not “individual players.”

2.title: 8 Key Findings From the Times/Siena Polls
2.summary: Democrats are competitive in Alaska, Iowa, Ohio, Texas and even Kansas as they try to wrest control of the Senate from Republicans. Here’s a look at why.

3.title: Here’s Senator Cotton’s Cell Number, Trump Says, in Dispute Over Daylight Saving Bill
3.summary: The president urged people to call Senator Tom Cotton of Arkansas and accused him of blocking a bill to cement daylight saving time.

4.title: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations
4.summary: Michael Kotlikoff described the allegations of a woman who says she was drugged and gang raped as "deeply disturbing".

5.title: Medical plane with 6 on board missing off Massachusetts coast
5.summary: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.

6.title: Russia Turns to Striking Kyiv’s Bridges, Threatening a Vital Lifeline
6.summary: The bridges, used by many commuters in the Ukrainian capital, are the latest target in a broad Russian bombing campaign against infrastructure.
